subject.title: [codex] fix(feishu): preserve post markdown line breaks

question: Should maintainers keep this draft branch as the Feishu newline candidate after rebase and repair, or choose another open Feishu newline PR as canonical?
rationale: Automation cannot safely close this PR as superseded because the proof-positive sibling is conflicting, and it cannot safely merge this branch because it has a routing regression, missing real proof, and merge conflicts.

options.title: Repair one canonical branch
options.body: Keep the cluster open, pick one branch, require raw-text routing plus post-only normalization, resolve conflicts, and require real Feishu proof before merge.

options.title: Adopt a different candidate
options.body: If another open Feishu newline PR is easier to rebase and prove, designate it as canonical and close the remaining candidates only after that path is clean and proof-positive.

options.title: Wait for current-main implementation
options.body: Leave this draft open until a clean canonical fix lands on main, then close the stale candidates as implemented or superseded with proof.

recommendation.title: Repair one canonical branch
recommendation.body: Keep the cluster open, pick one branch, require raw-text routing plus post-only normalization, resolve conflicts, and require real Feishu proof before merge.
